book.name: 1 TESALONICENSES
book.title: 1 TESALONICENSES Nacharam ẽsap Pabloou Tesalónicapienag phã deepʉ̈itarr

content: Ẽwandam oowai ʉ̈uum nem
Khodamnaan, maach Pör Jesús iekta maach iek gaai thʉwi ĩs marau pãrag magam ig nʉm: Ich jãg maachdëu pãachig jaautarrjö, Ẽwandamag pãach ʉ̈uu oomkhĩir, ar pãach nʉmjö ich jãg agpierraata wënʉrrathʉ̈.
Maach Pör Jesuu pãrag jaaupibaawai marau pãachig jaautarr ya pãrau khaphʉ nʉm.
Ẽwandamaun ãba ich atheepaita maachig nem wau wënʉrrapim khõsi sim; ni iwiir ãbjã dich õor khabam dʉ̈i khapese aba.
Magju khãai sĩi agdaujö dich ʉʉi chaar aunaa, i dʉ̈i agpierraanaa, aairaa aju aai nʉm, i dʉ̈i dichdëu ampierr aba;
mag dich ʉʉi dʉ̈i pawiajã, sĩi õor Ẽwandam khaugbam khʉʉnjö i dʉ̈i khĩir lököo khaba, sĩi i dʉ̈i khapes ajupaijã khĩirjuba.

Ni ãbmuajã oob dich khapeen ʉʉin wau sĩsid amiet, ni magʉm gaaimuajã pãach khapeen khũgurmiet. Na maachdëu pãach khĩircha jaau narrjö, magʉm paran Ẽwandamaujã jua khʉaba deejem, ichdëujã jãg khõchkhaba sĩerraawai.
Ẽwandamau maach ich athee jʉr autarr chan sĩi parhooba pekau wau wënʉrramkhĩir khabajim. Magju khãai ichdëu khõsi simjö ich athee nem wajapha wau nʉmpai wau wënʉrramkhĩirta maach ich dënkha aujim.

Magtarr aawai chamʉg nem wajapha wau nʉmta iseg sim wounaun chi jaau wënʉrrʉm khʉʉnta isegba, ich Ẽwandam ichdëu maachig ich Akhaar deejemchata iseg sim, chamʉg maachdëu jaau wënʉrrʉm iekjã i dën aawai.
Mʉg Ẽwandam iek ʉ̈kha nʉm gaaimua khodkha thʉnʉm khʉʉn aphajã warag chikham kha khõsi amkhĩir chan mua tag pãrag bʉ̈ʉrjã jaaupʉ̈ibam, ich Ẽwandamauchata ya pãar mag khõsi wënʉrraa khaugpi sĩewai.
Macedonia durram khʉʉn ʉ̈u pãar thum agdaujö chikham kha khõsi wënʉrraajem chadcha; magʉm ãba mamʉ marau waragta jũrr agdaujö dich khapeen daupii abat anʉm.
Khõinaa wënʉrrajuuta ẽkhanaa nem inagdam wauju aai nʉm khai, ag gaaipaita nʉisit. Pãach juadamaucha phidkhabat, nawe maachdëu pãachig jaaujemjö.
Maagwai bithurgam khʉʉn Ẽwandam iek ʉ̈khaba nʉm khʉʉnaujã pãach mag oowai, pãar ëugar khaigba iekhabaju; mag nʉm dʉ̈i ĩchab pãach mag phidkhaawai pãachdëu nem ig nʉm atheejã pãar augchëbaju.
Maach Pör Jesucristo bëeju Pabloou jaautarr
Khodamnaan, sĩi Ẽwandam iek ʉ̈khaba aajem khʉʉnjö pãach ökhĩirjuu apimaaugau, marau pãrag jaaum ig nʉm, jãga aajẽ mʉg maach Ẽwandam iek ʉ̈kha nʉm khʉʉn meewai.

Maadëu khaphʉ nʉm Jesús meewia deeu iiu phiidʉtarr. Magtarr aawai thãraucha i iek ʉ̈kha nʉm ötarr khʉʉnjã deeu ich Ẽwandamau phiriutkha auwia ich Jesús pierrum dʉ̈i bëejujã chadcha khaphʉ aju aai nʉm.

Magua maach Pör Jesús iekta maach iek gaai thʉwi pãrag khap amkhĩir marau mag nʉm: Maach Pör Jesús bëem ed maach agtha chi iiu durrum khʉʉn chan maach na khëchtarr khʉʉn na i khĩirphee pos aimabaju, maach nawe khëchtarr khʉʉnta nacha phiidʉtkhaju aawai.

Maach Pör Jesús ich bëem edan ichta nem iek theeg bëeju, Ẽwandam trompeta tẽe abarm dʉ̈i Arcangelau i pierrum jaauwai äa abarm ee. Mag ʉ̈gtharmua pierrwai Cristo iek ʉ̈kha nʉm meetarr khʉʉnta nacha iiu phiidʉtkhaju;
maimuata maach agtha chi iiu durrum khʉʉn sĩi ʉ̈gthaa edjã baug ee dëgölp jiirkha athamjö awi mag chi maach nawe meetarr khʉʉnpa ich mag i dʉ̈i ãba nʉisiju.
Mag i dʉ̈i ãba naaimaju aawai magʉm iek ig iyʉ̈ʉ nʉmuata warag agdaujö pãach khapeen khĩir onee apibat.
